name: Flecha Cantina
notes: Own site (flechacantina.com) links to the restaurant's own Paytronix/Nuxt ordering platform (orderexperience.net), fully client-rendered with no server data, so the specific 4S Ranch location (address-matched: 10514 Craftsman Way, San Diego 92127) was selected live in Chrome and every category read via get_page_text after clicking through Takeout/ASAP (store/fulfillment-type confirmation only, no personal data entered). Covered 8 core categories (Antojitos, Ceviches, Sopa Y Ensaladas, Taqueria, Enchiladas, Platillos, Kids, Postres) plus 4 seasonal Summer categories (Summer Antojitos, Summer Ensalada, Summer Especialidades, Summer Postres) that were live on the site at extraction time; Catering was excluded as an adjunct (bulk/event ordering, not a dish menu). Several items are build-your-own with a required protein-choice modifier and no listed base price on the category grid - for these (Nachos, Balsamic Beet Salad, Caesar Salad, Fajita Salad, Vampiro Tacos) the item detail modal was opened and the CHEAPEST available required-choice price was recorded as the item price, noted per-dish. Five items could not be confidently priced despite repeated attempts (their detail modals would not reliably open or showed no price/no modifier list at all, unlike the others) and were dropped rather than guessed: Mole Enchiladas, Burrito, Chile Relleno, Quesadilla (all in Platillos/Enchiladas - Burrito/Chile Relleno/Quesadilla in Platillos show no price on the grid and their modals did not render pricing), and Verano Watermelon Salad (Summer Ensalada, same issue). Platillos section is therefore thin (1 of 4 items priced, Wagyu Burger) - flagged as a real gap in this capture, not a claim that those dishes don't exist. Espinaca Fundido appeared identically priced under both Antojitos and Summer Antojitos and was recorded once. No third-party cross-check needed; this is the restaurant's own live ordering platform with non-round POS-style pricing (no markup signature).
